The '''Mahogany Bench''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|2000}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

==Bugs==
*When rotated to face north, the back of the bench will appear as bars like the other types of wooden bench, instead of the solid back panel when viewed from the front.
